feeds.title: Cleveland Scene
feeds.description: Welcome to the Cleveland Scene. It is a place where you will find information on various topics such as news, movies, music, food, arts, events, and much more. The Scene Magazine has served as the city's premiere, award-winning multimedia source of alternative news, events, and culture since 1970.

feeds.title: FOX 8 News » Cleveland
feeds.description: Cleveland's source for news, weather, Cleveland Browns, Cleveland Indians, and Cleveland Cavaliers team updates.

feeds.title: Cleveland Urban News
feeds.description: This is your urban news connection with national political news and news from the Cleveland, Ohio area from an urban perspective. We are dedicated to the disenfranchised, including Blacks, women, and the poor. Highlighted issues include articles on politics, judicial malfeasance, racism, sexism, education, and minority and grassroots empowerment.

feeds.title: NewsTalk 1490 WERE
feeds.description: NewsTalk 1490 WERE is Cleveland's leading News Talk Radio Station delivering Cleveland Ohio news and events, entertainment news, and national news throughout the day. Check out our website for additional local coverage, program schedules and trending updates on air.

feeds.title: FOX 8 News
feeds.description: Highlighting local issues and topics through in-depth, insightful stories and videos, FOX 8 News is Cleveland's source for news, weather, Browns, Guardians, and Cavs. Read all their updates, featured articles, special reports, and more web-exclusive news material at FOX 8 News.

feeds.title: Spectrum News Cleveland
feeds.description: Get breaking news, local headlines, weather alerts, live streaming video, and more from Spectrum News, your source for Cleveland news. Spectrum News 1 is a 24/7 hyperlocal content network that delivers news and information on the issues that unite Ohioans, and remains committed to covering the stories that matter most to its viewers across the state of Ohio.

feeds.title: Signal Cleveland
feeds.description: Read the latest community news and commentaries from Cleveland. Signal Cleveland is a non-profit newsroom that fuses community building with local news reporting. We produce authoritative, trustworthy daily journalism across a range of topics, including government, economy, education, health, safety, and resilience.

feeds.title: Cleveland.com
feeds.description: Cleveland.com stands as Ohio's foremost source for comprehensive news and information, spanning local and national topics. From weather updates to traffic reports, and sports coverage to arts and entertainment, it offers a diverse range of content including videos, photos, forums, and up-to-date news articles, serving the Northeast Ohio community with reliable and timely information.

feeds.title: News 5 Cleveland
feeds.description: News 5 Cleveland brings you Cleveland news, weather, traffic, and sports from the Cleveland metro area and across Ohio News5Cleveland.com. One of the oldest television stations in the state of Ohio, News 5 is a Scripps-owned ABC affiliate based in Cleveland.

feeds.title: EJBNEWS
feeds.description: EJBNEWS is a right-leaning Cleveland News organization run entirely by veteran influential journalist Eric Jonathan Brewer. Eric is a reporter and a social personality known for his critical, hard-hitting right-wing views. EJBNEWS mainly focuses on Political scoops and rumors with a strongly critical perspective.

feeds.title: Cleveland Business Journal
feeds.description: Cleveland Business Journal supplies business executives and general readers with the latest breaking business news, updated throughout the day, this week's top stories from the Cleveland Business Journal, and other popular features from the website. The Cleveland Business Journal is part of the American Business Journals group of business weeklies.
